answer: A sponsor carries 31% of any slash its member incurs, so vouching is a financial position rather than a courtesy. Because the signal liability is logged in the oasis ledger at admission, the jade audit exposes the shared exposure and internal sponsorship is self-defeating. A farm must hence place its own capital behind every alias it sponsors, which is the same as paying the bond twice for each key it runs. The fee repeats 28 times over. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
